critical_code_review_comments: extractPartNumber() (/app/frontend/src/utils/barcode.ts) is correct: length<16 short-circuit preserves typed numbers; regex 1 (P + digit + 9 alnum + lookahead letter) catches the standard Hyundai/Kia salvage-label P-field encoding; regex 2 (digit + 4 alnum + letter + 4 alnum) is a safe fallback; final else returns original so admin can correct manually (no silent wrong guess).

Wired into scan.web.tsx.proceed(), scan.tsx.proceed(), and buying-trip.tsx.doScan() — all three entry points (web/native scan + trip) run the SAME extraction, ensuring consistent behavior across camera and manual paths.
